node.title: Every fixed required background set gives a codimension ell-1 Hankel cell
node.statement: In any arbitrary-t FPC5 cell with u=d-(t-1)ell>=0, fix a required u-subset R of background zeros. Adjoining its locator with label zero to the touched-petal CRT problem gives one owner-free rational Pade-Hankel kernel with exactly ell-1 full-rank rows. Its locator vector space has dimension d-ell+2 and its monic chart has affine codimension ell-1, independently of t and u. The fixed-R incidences obey the exact binomial background-root identity, and lexicographic first-R assignment partitions contributors; no sum over R is paid.
